title: Les règles de sécurité
oneGoal: Students learn the basic safety rules for science class
decisionPoints: How comfortable are students with French science vocabulary?
Should we practice safety gestures more or move to examples?
Are students ready to identify unsafe situations?
progression: Foundation lesson - establishing essential safety practices before any exploration

title: Mes yeux observent
oneGoal: Students learn to observe safely with their eyes only
decisionPoints: Are students remembering safety rules from lesson 1?
Should we extend looking activities or move to drawing?
What level of French support is needed for describing?
progression: Builds on safety foundation by introducing safe observation using sight only

title: Toucher en sécurité
oneGoal: Students learn safe touching rules and gentle exploration
decisionPoints: Are students following safe looking rules consistently?
Should we practice gentle touch more or introduce new materials?
How are students responding to French instructions?
progression: Expands safe observation to include careful touching after establishing visual observation

title: Écouter les sons
oneGoal: Students use their ears safely to explore sounds
decisionPoints: Are students maintaining safe touching practices?
Should we make more sounds or focus on identifying them?
Is the noise level appropriate for learning?
progression: Adds safe listening to observation skills while reinforcing previous safety practices

title: Sentir avec prudence
oneGoal: Students learn safe smelling techniques with appropriate materials
decisionPoints: Are students comfortable with all previous senses?
Should we try more scents or focus on describing them?
Are students using proper smelling technique?
progression: Introduces safe smelling while integrating all previously learned observation skills

title: Objets sécuritaires
oneGoal: Students identify and safely manipulate classroom science materials
decisionPoints: Are students applying all sense safety rules consistently?
Should we introduce more materials or practice with current ones?
How confident are students with safe manipulation?
progression: Applies all learned safety skills to handling appropriate science materials

title: Observer ensemble
oneGoal: Students work together to observe materials using all senses safely
decisionPoints: Are students ready for partner work or need more individual practice?
Should we focus on turn-taking or expand observations?
How are students communicating their observations in French?
progression: Combines individual safety skills with collaborative observation practices

title: Vivant ou non-vivant?
oneGoal: Students begin to distinguish between living and non-living things safely
decisionPoints: Are students maintaining safety with all observation tools?
Should we use more examples or focus on student explanations?
Are students ready to observe actual living things?
progression: Introduces living things concept using safe observation skills from previous lessons

title: Les plantes autour de nous
oneGoal: Students safely observe and identify basic plant characteristics
decisionPoints: Are students applying safety rules with living materials?
Should we observe more plant parts or focus on current ones?
How detailed should plant observations be?
progression: Applies safe observation skills to explore plant characteristics and features

title: Les animaux et nous
oneGoal: Students safely observe and discuss animal characteristics including humans
decisionPoints: Are students maintaining gentle observation practices?
Should we compare more animals or focus on similarities?
Are students making connections to themselves as animals?
progression: Extends living things understanding to animals while maintaining all safety practices

title: Comparer les vivants
oneGoal: Students compare characteristics between plants, animals, and humans safely
decisionPoints: Are students confident distinguishing living categories?
Should we add more examples or deepen current comparisons?
How are students expressing comparisons in French?
progression: Synthesizes plant and animal learning to make comparisons while using safe practices

title: Scientifiques sécuritaires
oneGoal: Students demonstrate all safety skills while exploring like scientists
decisionPoints: Are students independently applying all safety rules?
Should we extend exploration time or focus on sharing discoveries?
How confident are students as young scientists?
progression: Integrates all safety and observation skills in independent scientific exploration

title: Nos découvertes
oneGoal: Students share and explain their observations using proper science vocabulary
decisionPoints: Are students using science vocabulary confidently?
Should we practice more explanations or celebrate discoveries?
How can we support students' French expression?
progression: Consolidates learning by having students communicate discoveries using acquired vocabulary

title: Révision complète
oneGoal: Students demonstrate mastery of all safety rules and observation skills
decisionPoints: Which skills need more reinforcement before extensions?
Are students ready for independent science exploration?
Should we assess formally or through observation?
progression: Final core lesson ensuring all curriculum expectations are met and assessed

title: Jardin d'exploration
oneGoal: Students apply safety skills while exploring outdoor living things
decisionPoints: How are students adapting safety rules to outdoor environment?
Should we explore more areas or deepen current observations?
What additional safety considerations are needed outside?
progression: Extension activity applying learned skills in new outdoor environment

title: Créer des collections
oneGoal: Students safely collect and organize non-living natural materials
decisionPoints: Are students selecting safe materials for collections?
Should we focus on sorting methods or finding more items?
How can students explain their organizing choices?
progression: Creative extension allowing students to practice classification skills safely

title: Art scientifique
oneGoal: Students create art representations of their scientific observations
decisionPoints: Should we focus on accuracy or creativity in representations?
Are students incorporating scientific vocabulary into art descriptions?
How can we display student work to celebrate learning?
progression: Creative extension connecting science observations with artistic expression

title: Histoires de science
oneGoal: Students tell stories about their scientific discoveries and observations
decisionPoints: Are students incorporating safety messages in their stories?
Should we focus on storytelling skills or science content?
How can we encourage creativity while maintaining accuracy?
progression: Language-rich extension connecting science learning with narrative skills

title: Enseigner aux autres
oneGoal: Students teach safety rules and observation skills to younger students
decisionPoints: Are students confident enough to teach others?
Should we practice teaching more or focus on actual interactions?
How can we support students as they explain concepts?
progression: Leadership extension where students demonstrate mastery by teaching others

title: Célébration scientifique
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth as safe, observant young scientists
decisionPoints: How can we best showcase student learning and growth?
Should we focus on individual achievements or group success?
What evidence of learning should be highlighted?
progression: Culminating celebration recognizing student growth and scientific thinking development
